title: Take Off
desc: Sameera, an Indian nurse working in Iraq, and her colleagues are held hostage by terrorists. Indian ambassador Manoj uses his wit and shrewdness to rescue them and get them out of the country alive.

title: Thani Oruvan
desc: Mithran, a police officer, pledges to reveal the lies and malpractices of Siddharth Abhimanyu, a renowned scientist, who uses illegal methods to make a profit.

title: Honey Bee
desc: A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.

title: 7aum Arivu
desc: Dong Lee from China arrives in India to start a biological war. However, a genetic engineering student tries to revive the skills of Bodhidharma with the help of his descendant to defeat Dong Lee.

title: Kadha Parayumbol
desc: Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.

title: Rekka
desc: After preventing a gangster, David, from marrying a girl against her wishes, Shiva's life is complicated by a kidnapping.
